_about: Provenance for public/assets/sprites/crowd/<key>.png. Characters generated with PixelLab (create_character standard mode + animate_character template walking-8-frames; poses via create_character_state with use_color_palette_from_reference=true). Download zip (holds every state of the character's group): https://api.pixellab.ai/mcp/characters/<id>/download -> cache as /tmp/pixellab-crowd/<key>.zip, then run python3 scripts/build-crowd-sheets.py.

pose_state_edit_descriptions.sit_bench: sitting down on an invisible seat at knee height, thighs horizontal, knees bent, feet flat on the ground, relaxed, hands resting on lap. Only the person is drawn: no bench, no chair, no furniture, no ground.
pose_state_edit_descriptions.sit_ground: sitting cross-legged on the grass, relaxed, hands resting on knees. Only the person is drawn: no grass, no ground, no blanket, no shadow.
pose_state_edit_descriptions.selfie: holding a smartphone up at arm's length taking a selfie
pose_state_edit_descriptions.smoke: standing, smoking a cigarette, hand raised to mouth
pose_state_edit_descriptions._why_sit_wording: The requested 'sitting on a park bench, relaxed, hands resting on lap' drew a full wooden bench into the sprite (state a9f8fcb8-4d91-4729-84b0-79a98ed6799b on officeMan, unused). The map already draws bench tiles, so sit poses are prop-free; sit_ground likewise forbids grass/ground.

sheet_layout.row_4: cols 0-3 stand S/E/N/W (base rotations); col 4 selfie (south); col 5 smoke (south); cols 6-7 empty
sheet_layout.row_5: cols 0-3 sit_bench S/E/N/W; cols 4-7 sit_ground S/E/N/W
sheet_layout.frame_index: row*8+col: stand 32-35, selfie 36, smoke 37, sit_bench 40-43, sit_ground 44-47
sheet_layout.alignment: walk + stand copied raw (shared 68px canvas); every pose rotation shifted vertically so its lowest opaque row = the base south rotation's lowest opaque row. Missing poses are transparent.
sheet_layout.north_sit_note: north (from behind) sit cells: the lowest opaque row is the seat/legs, not the feet, so they align the seat to the feet row

rejected_states.a9f8fcb8-4d91-4729-84b0-79a98ed6799b: sit_bench with a bench drawn into the sprite
